brochureContent.Content:
STUNNING 6 BEDROOM GEORGIAN HOME ON 3 ACRES IN MALLOW

Savills are delighted to present Duarigle, Navigation Road, Mallow, Co. Cork a splendid six bedroom detached period residence dating from c.1835, set on approximately 3 acres of mature, private grounds, and extending to c.4,250 sq ft of elegant accommodation.

Positioned just a short stroll from the heart of Mallow and within convenient reach of Cork City (c.34 km), Duarigle offers a rare opportunity to acquire a distinguished country home combining historic charm with modern family living. All amenities are within walking distance including schools, shops, restaurants, sporting facilities and excellent transport links, with Mallow Train Station just 500 metres away. Originally known as Sunny Hill, the property occupies an elevated position on the western edge of Mallow, enhancing natural light and outlook across the surrounding landscape. Built in the early 19th century and extended in the 1960s, the property has been meticulously maintained and thoughtfully modernised, while preserving a wealth of original features such as ornate cornicing, marble fireplaces and sash windows.

A welcoming entrance porch with fanlight leads through double doors into a magnificent reception hall, a defining feature of the home with elegant proportions, fine detailing and a sweeping staircase. To the left, a beautifully proportioned sitting room enjoys a sunny southerly aspect, with large windows and a striking marble fireplace. This connects to a formal dining room, ideal for entertaining, with intricate cornicing and garden views. To the southwest lies a bright and spacious living room with marble fireplace, stove and superb outlook over the grounds. On the opposite side, a rear hall leads to a generous guest WC and a comfortable family room with fireplace stove and large window. The kitchen/dining room is a warm and inviting space, featuring a country style kitchen by Abbey Kitchens, centred around a traditional AGA, and offering direct access to the rear yard.

Upstairs, six generously sized bedrooms are arranged around a bright landing, all benefiting from large sash windows. The principal bedroom includes a luxurious en suite with jacuzzi bath and separate shower, complemented by a family bathroom and additional shower room.

The gardens at Duarigle are truly magnificent, with large sunny lawns, a superb selection of mature trees and shrubs, and excellent privacy throughout. Private gates open to a long gravel driveway, creating a wonderful sense of arrival. To the rear, a substantial cut stone coach house and stable block, accessed via a traditional stone archway, offer superb potential for conversion (subject to planning). With six stables and extensive grounds, the property is ideal for equestrian use.

Historically associated with notable Cork families including the De La Cour and Sarsfield families, and later serving as a rectory before returning to private ownership, Duarigle is a residence of true distinction, offering scale, elegance and versatility, with the rare advantage of town convenience.

• Beautiful Six Bedroom Georgian Home
  • Huge Potential Equestrian Development
  • Approx. 395 sq m / 4250 sq ft
  • Situated approx. 1.25 hectares / 3 acres
  • Basement Approx. 156 sq m / 1685 sq ft
  • Fantastic Private Gardens with separate walled garden
  • Located on the edge of Mallow Town & all Amenities
  • Only 500m from train/bus, 32km from Cork city

28 Newlyn Vale is a well-presented four-bedroom detached family home (135 m²) situated in the highly sought after suburb of Rochestown. The property is located in a sought-after corner site and is south facing onto the Rochestown road. This home has been well maintained and benefits from bright reception rooms, well-proportioned bedrooms and superb outdoor space with front, back and side gardens. The property has ample room for extension to the side. To the front, a generous driveway provides off-street parking for up to three cars.

This presents an excellent opportunity to acquire a family home ideally suited to modern living in one of Cork’s most desirable residential locations.

The property enjoys excellent connectivity, with easy access to the South Link Road and Cork City, while Douglas is just a two-minute drive away. There is a wide range of local amenities on your doorstep to include schools, shops and sporting clubs etc.  

Ground Floor: 
Entrance Porch - with tiled floor.

Hallway - with polished timber floor and under stairs storage cupboard.

Living Room – with carpet floor covering, marble open fireplace and large window overlooking front.

Sitting/Dining room – with polished timber floor, marble open fireplace and sliding door with access to the rear and side gardens. 

Kitchen – with polished timber floor, floor & eye level fitted units and with integrated appliances. Door to rear garden. 

Utility room – with WHB, plumbed for washer and dryer and doors to kitchen and garage/store.

Wet room – with tiled floor and walls, WHB, WC and walk in shower. 

Garage/Store – with polished timber flooring.

First Floor: 

Bedroom 1 – with carpet floor covering, built-in floor length robe units with integrated dressing table.
Ensuite – with WC, WHB and shower. 

Bedroom 2 - with carpet floor covering, built-in floor length robe units with integrated dressing table.

Bedroom 3 - with carpet floor covering and built-in floor length robe unit.

Main bathroom – with tiled floor and walls, bath with shower over, WC & WHB.

Bedroom 4 - with carpet floor covering, built-in floor length robe units with vanity mirror.

- Ample parking in front driveway.
- Well maintained gardens.
- Generous rear patio.
- Oil fired central heating & PVC double glazed windows. 
- Gated side entrances.
- Well maintained house.

This character-filled home has thoughtfully created a comfortable family residence. Extending to approximately 212.09 sq. m. (2,300 sq. ft.), the property offers flexible and well-proportioned accommodation ideally suited for family living.

Set behind mature boundaries and approached via a private driveway, Young Grove enjoys a peaceful countryside setting while remaining just 10 minutes from Midleton town centre and the N25, offering easy access to Cork City, Waterford and beyond.

Residents can enjoy country walks and a host of outdoor pursuits, while Midleton provides an excellent range of schools, shopping, cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities.

 Young Grove is nestled in a peaceful and picturesque setting on the outskirts of Midleton, this delightful property offers a rare combination of rural tranquillity and beautiful mature gardens. 

Accommodation comprises: Entrance Hall, Living Room, Kitchen / Dining Room, Sunroom, 4-bedrooms, 4 bathrooms & attic space.

Accommodation:

Ground Floor	 

Entrance Hall:	Welcoming entrance hallway providing access to the principal reception rooms and staircase to first floor. Ornate cornicing featured on the ceiling.

Living Room:	A comfortable family reception room centred around an open fireplace with solid timber flooring and bay windows. Access to sunroom from living room.

Kitchen / Dining Room:	A cozy kitchen/dining area with tiled & laminate flooring and a multi fuel stove. Built in kitchen units with integrated oven, hob & dishwasher. Bay windows lightening the room.
                                                
Sunroom:	Spacious, open space with laminate flooring. Windows giving access to light into the room. Sunroom gives access to side garden.

 Utility Room:	Washer & dryer unit, storage and w.h.b

Bathroom:                                    Fully tiled flooring with w.h.b, w.c. & bath. Hot-press is also located in bathroom.                           

Attic Space

Bedroom 3:                                  A spacious room currently being used as a bedroom benefitting from extensive fitted storage and private en-suite


accommodation.
  
En-Suite:                                      Comprising W.C., wash hand basin and electric shower.
          
Bedroom 4:                                 Generous room currently being used as a bedroom overlooking the surrounding countryside and benefitting from private en-suite accommodation.

En-Suite 2:	Comprising W.C., wash hand basin and electric shower.
    	
Outside:    	Occupying a mature site extending to approximately 0.34 acres, Young Grove enjoys a private setting with beautifully maintained gardens and a variety of outdoor living spaces designed to maximise the property's tranquil countryside setting. A gravel driveway provides extensive parking and access to the detached garage with roller doors and side access.

brochureContent.Content: Bowe Property presents to the market a truly stunning and exceptional property at Seskin, Bantry. Now offered for sale for the first time since its inception in 1996. Set on a impressive land holding of approx 1.6 acres with significant road frontage and possible divisibility. This is a home of style, substance and space and privacy. This is a truly beautiful and impressive property on every level. Approached from an automated gated entrance with regimental pillars over a sweeping approach to the residence and framed by exceptional views overlooking Bantry Bay, the coastline and islands of the south west of Ireland. This is a property that was meticulously planned, detailed and appointed by its original home owners who fastidiously set about presenting a very interesting property with many genuine Georgian period features to deliver a home that is quite simply, handsome and hypnotic. Accommodation over two floors consists of, four bedrooms, two ensuite, family bathroom, garden w.c, formal reception room, sun conservatory, handcrafted fitted kitchen, dining room with separate back hall and utility room with all the accommodation connected to a beautiful entrance hall with an authentic Georgian staircase, Salvaged  hard wooden Floor, ornate ceiling cornicing and French style internal glazed doors. Room proportions are generous and the property extends to approximately 230sq.m. It is a house that is cohesive and practical with that wonderful blend of a bygone era with all of todays pleasant conveniences. Features are numerous throughout the property and include Georgian style double glazed sash panel windows, genuine Adams fireplace, hardwood floors, Georgian internal doors with original ironmongery and period front door brassware, oil fired central heating, fan light entrance, dressing rooms, ensuite bedrooms and  much, much more. The property is dressed in a limewashed yellow orchre pigment and crowned with reclaimed slate giving the property a wonderful natural low maintenance but an impression of the house being much older than is the case. The house is complemented by beautiful rolling grounds that are mature, private and simply a perfect place to spend time overlooking Bantry town, all of Bantry Bay and its wonderful coastline. The approach to the house is sweeping and rising to a level plateau located to maximise the benefit of its wonderful sunny orientation and outlook. An impressive garden patio to the rear of the house is accessed from the sun conservatory ideal for al-fresco dining and leisure time. A truly unique and special property on a wonderful private site that has been carefully, stylishly and meticulously detailed makes this a most unique offering and is in every sense of the phrase “a once in a life time opportunity”. Viewings are invited and are strictly by private application.

BrochureContent.Content: Bowe Property presents to the market a truly stunning and exceptional property at Seskin, Bantry. Now offered for sale for the first time since its inception in 1996. Set on a impressive land holding of approx 1.6 acres with significant road frontage and possible divisibility. This is a home of style, substance and space and privacy. This is a truly beautiful and impressive property on every level. Approached from an automated gated entrance with regimental pillars over a sweeping approach to the residence and framed by exceptional views overlooking Bantry Bay, the coastline and islands of the south west of Ireland. This is a property that was meticulously planned, detailed and appointed by its original home owners who fastidiously set about presenting a very interesting property with many genuine Georgian period features to deliver a home that is quite simply, handsome and hypnotic. Accommodation over two floors consists of, four bedrooms, two ensuite, family bathroom, garden w.c, formal reception room, sun conservatory, handcrafted fitted kitchen, dining room with separate back hall and utility room with all the accommodation connected to a beautiful entrance hall with an authentic Georgian staircase, Salvaged  hard wooden Floor, ornate ceiling cornicing and French style internal glazed doors. Room proportions are generous and the property extends to approximately 230sq.m. It is a house that is cohesive and practical with that wonderful blend of a bygone era with all of todays pleasant conveniences. Features are numerous throughout the property and include Georgian style double glazed sash panel windows, genuine Adams fireplace, hardwood floors, Georgian internal doors with original ironmongery and period front door brassware, oil fired central heating, fan light entrance, dressing rooms, ensuite bedrooms and  much, much more. The property is dressed in a limewashed yellow orchre pigment and crowned with reclaimed slate giving the property a wonderful natural low maintenance but an impression of the house being much older than is the case. The house is complemented by beautiful rolling grounds that are mature, private and simply a perfect place to spend time overlooking Bantry town, all of Bantry Bay and its wonderful coastline. The approach to the house is sweeping and rising to a level plateau located to maximise the benefit of its wonderful sunny orientation and outlook. An impressive garden patio to the rear of the house is accessed from the sun conservatory ideal for al-fresco dining and leisure time. A truly unique and special property on a wonderful private site that has been carefully, stylishly and meticulously detailed makes this a most unique offering and is in every sense of the phrase “a once in a life time opportunity”. Viewings are invited and are strictly by private application.
